profile.facility_type_note: Part of Digital Realty's Silicon Valley (Santa Clara/San Jose area) data center campus, one of the company's largest US clusters. Two facilities in this group carry independent historic significance: 360 Spear Street and 365 Main Street in San Francisco are separate, well known carrier hotel buildings; 365 Main Street was the site of a widely covered July 2007 power outage that took down major web services including Craigslist and other sites hosted there, later becoming a Digital Realty/Digital Realty-heritage asset. SJC10 is documented at 1100 Space Park Drive per Digital Realty's own site.

reading.body:
Digital Realty's SJC11 facility in Santa Clara covers 91,000 square feet and includes N+1 cooling redundancy. The operator has not published a power capacity figure for this building, so its IT load cannot be calculated from available data.

This facility is part of Digital Realty's larger Silicon Valley campus cluster in the Santa Clara and San Jose area. California has 103 mapped data center facilities, of which only 11 operators publish megawatt capacity figures. Those 11 facilities account for 365 MW of published capacity combined. Without a published figure, SJC11's scale relative to other California sites cannot be established from this site's sources.

The absence of a power spec means SJC11 cannot be ranked among California's published capacity. Whether this represents a small colocation building, a large facility the operator has chosen not to disclose capacity for, or a site in transition is not determinable from published information. To assess this campus's role in AI infrastructure, published power capacity or reliable third-party measurement would be required.
